message.content: Rowan finds several aspects of Jaime Lannister's storyline intriguing. One particular point of interest is Jaime's transformation from an arrogant knight into someone who exhibits depth and complexity, particularly after his relationship with Brienne of Tarth. Rowan notes that their journey together forces Jaime to confront his moral compass and forces him to grow in ways he hadn't previously. Additionally, Rowan appreciates Jaime's bond with Brienne, which brings out his honor and humanity, showcasing a significant catalyst in Jaime's evolution.
